title: Format API
description: The product's format reference, at `/api/format`, served by `lathe serve` and the app's Vite plugin alike, for the app's format pages. It answers JSON, and any method but GET with 405.

title: History API
description: A record's git history, at `/api/history`, served by `lathe serve`, the app's Vite plugin and the desktop app alike. It answers JSON, and any method but GET with 405.

title: Spec API
description: The loaded workspace, at `/api/spec`, served by `lathe serve`, the app's Vite plugin and the desktop app alike. It answers JSON, and any method but GET with 405.
